role.en: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, AMI (Advanced Machine Intelligence Labs)
role.zh: AMI（Advanced Machine Intelligence Labs）联合创始人兼首席科学家

why.en: Turing laureate and father of the convolutional network. His position that autoregressive LLMs cannot reach AGI is the most important dissenting voice in the field — and he has now raised over a billion dollars to prove it.
why.zh: 图灵奖得主、卷积网络之父。他「自回归大模型走不到 AGI」的立场是这个领域最重要的反共识声音 —— 现在他已募得逾十亿美元来证明它。

title.en: World models and the next AI revolution
title.zh: 世界模型与下一次 AI 革命

posts.source: Frontiers of Embodied AI, ETH Zürich

note.en: Contrasts generative architectures with JEPA, which predicts representations rather than pixels.
note.zh: 将生成式架构与 JEPA 对比 —— 后者预测的是表征而非像素。

title.en: Self-supervised learning, JEPA, world models and the future of AI
title.zh: 自监督学习、JEPA、世界模型与 AI 的未来

title.en: A Path Towards Autonomous Machine Intelligence
title.zh: 通向自主机器智能的路径

note.en: The position paper that laid out the whole world-model programme AMI is now funded to build.
note.zh: 这篇立场论文奠定了 AMI 如今获得融资去建造的整个世界模型纲领。

title.en: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
title.zh: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics

note.en: Strips the hand-tuned heuristics out of video pretraining, cutting the cost of learning representations from video at scale.
note.zh: 去掉视频预训练中人工调校的启发式技巧，降低大规模视频表征学习的成本。

title.en: Advancing human-centric AI for robust X-ray analysis through holistic self-supervised learning
title.zh: Advancing human-centric AI for robust X-ray analysis through holistic self-supervised learning

note.en: A Meta FAIR/NYU collaboration applying self-supervised representation learning (RayDINO) to make chest X-ray analysis more robust and clinically reliable.
note.zh: Meta FAIR与纽约大学合作的论文，将自监督表征学习（RayDINO）应用于胸部X光分析，使其更加稳健、更贴近临床需求。

title.en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
title.zh: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI

note.en: A Prior Labs release for relational learning that open-sources a benchmark, a relational variant of TabPFN and a baseline library; he is one of its co-authors.
note.zh: Prior Labs 面向关系学习的开源发布，包含一个基准、TabPFN 的关系版本和一套基线库，他是共同作者之一。

title.en: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability
title.zh: Self-supervised DXA representations encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability

note.en: Self-supervised representations of whole-body DXA scans that turn out to encode multi-system disease risk, biological aging and heritability — his self-supervised approach applied to medical imaging.
note.zh: 用自监督方法学习全身 DXA 扫描的表征，发现其中编码了多系统疾病风险、生理衰老与遗传度——他把自监督学习用到了医学影像上。

title.en: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
title.zh: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning

note.en: Extends his joint-embedding predictive architecture to graphs, using hierarchical partitioning to learn representations at several resolutions at once.
note.zh: 把他提出的联合嵌入预测架构扩展到图数据，通过层次划分同时在多个分辨率上学习表征。

title.en: Music-JEPA: Learning a World Model of Sound from Action
title.zh: Music-JEPA: Learning a World Model of Sound from Action

note.en: Applies the JEPA framework to audio, learning a world model of sound from action.
note.zh: 把 JEPA 框架用于音频，从动作出发学习声音的世界模型。

title.en: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
title.zh: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations

note.en: With NYU's robot learning group, shows that dense per-patch vision-transformer features make robot policies more effective than compressing each observation into one global vector.
note.zh: 与纽约大学机器人学习团队合作，证明使用 ViT 的稠密图块特征比把每帧观测压缩成单个全局向量更有效。

title.en: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
title.zh: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders

note.en: Argues that BERT-style encoders conflate representation with reconstruction, and separates the two to make text encoders scale.
note.zh: 指出 BERT 式编码器把表征和重建混为一谈，将两者分离后文本编码器才得以扩展规模。

title.en: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
title.zh: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model

note.en: An adaptive latent world model that keeps updating at test time instead of staying frozen when its predictions start to degrade.
note.zh: 一种自适应的隐空间世界模型，在测试阶段预测开始变差时继续更新，而不是保持冻结。

title.en: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
title.zh: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors

note.en: Applies JEPA world models to quadrotor control, transferring long-horizon predictions from simulation to real flight without fine-tuning.
note.zh: 把 JEPA 世界模型用于四旋翼控制，将长时程预测零样本地从仿真迁移到真实飞行。

title.en: S-JEPA : Soft Clustering Anchors for Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning
title.zh: S-JEPA : Soft Clustering Anchors for Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning

note.en: Replaces hard cluster-ID prediction in self-supervised speech encoders with soft clustering anchors, which stops acoustic ambiguity being collapsed at category boundaries.
note.zh: 在自监督语音编码器中用软聚类锚点取代硬聚类 ID 预测，避免在类别边界上抹掉声学上的模糊性。

title.en: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences
title.zh: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences

note.en: Learns visual representations with a temporal-difference objective, arguing that as compute grows the methods assuming least tend to win.
note.zh: 用时序差分目标学习视觉表征，并论证随着算力增长，假设越少的方法往往越占优势。

title.en: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
title.zh: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks

note.en: Combines object-centric world models with a diffusion policy in a hierarchical controller for multi-stage robotic tasks.
note.zh: 把以物体为中心的世界模型与扩散策略结合成一个分层控制器，用于多阶段机器人任务。

title.en: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
title.zh: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?

note.en: Analyses under what conditions LeJEPA, his joint-embedding predictive architecture line, actually learns a usable world model.
note.zh: 分析在什么条件下 LeJEPA（他主张的联合嵌入预测架构路线）才真正学到可用的世界模型。

title.en: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
title.zh: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation

note.en: An open platform that standardises codebases, datasets and evaluation for world-model research, which the paper argues is currently fragmented.
note.zh: 一个开放平台，为世界模型研究统一代码库、数据集与评测；论文认为该领域目前过于碎片化。

title.en: Multi-modal AI for comprehensive breast cancer prognostication
title.zh: Multi-modal AI for comprehensive breast cancer prognostication

note.en: A large multi-institution study, with LeCun among the authors, building multi-modal AI models to predict breast cancer outcomes from imaging and clinical data.
note.zh: 一项多机构合作研究，杨立昆参与其中，构建结合影像与临床数据的多模态AI模型以预测乳腺癌预后。

title.en: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong
title.zh: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong

note.en: A long interview on why he left Meta, why he holds that the LLM paradigm is a dead end, and where he parts ways with Hinton.
note.zh: 长篇访谈，谈他离开 Meta 的原因、为何认为大语言模型路线是死胡同，以及他与辛顿的分歧所在。

title.en: Crys-JEPA: Accelerating Crystal Discovery via Embedding Screening and Generative Refinement
title.zh: Crys-JEPA: Accelerating Crystal Discovery via Embedding Screening and Generative Refinement

note.en: Uses JEPA embeddings to screen candidate crystals before generative refinement, aiming at materials that are stable and novel rather than merely realistic.
note.zh: 先用 JEPA 嵌入筛选候选晶体，再做生成式精修，目标是稳定且新颖的材料，而不只是看起来合理的材料。

title.en: TabPFN-3: Technical Report
title.zh: TabPFN-3: Technical Report

note.en: The technical report for the third generation of TabPFN, Prior Labs' foundation model for tabular data, on which he is a co-author.
note.zh: Prior Labs 表格数据基础模型 TabPFN 第三代的技术报告，他是共同作者之一。

title.en: On Training in Imagination
title.zh: On Training in Imagination

note.en: Examines model-based reinforcement learning that trains policies on imagined rollouts from a learned dynamics model.
note.zh: 研究基于模型的强化学习——用学到的动力学模型生成的想象轨迹来训练策略。

title.en: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
title.zh: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models

note.en: Attacks the compounding prediction error that breaks world-model planners on long-horizon tasks by planning hierarchically in latent space.
note.zh: 通过在隐空间中分层规划，解决世界模型规划器在长时程任务上误差累积的问题。

title.en: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science
title.zh: Why AI systems don't learn and what to do about it: Lessons on autonomous learning from cognitive science

note.en: A position paper with Emmanuel Dupoux and Jitendra Malik on why current AI systems cannot learn autonomously, proposing an architecture drawn from human and animal cognition.
note.zh: 与 Emmanuel Dupoux、Jitendra Malik 合写的立场论文，论述当前 AI 系统为何无法自主学习，并提出一种借鉴人类与动物认知的架构。

title.en: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
title.zh: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning

note.en: The 2.1 release of V-JEPA, adding dense image and video features to his video self-supervised model family while keeping its global scene understanding.
note.zh: V-JEPA 2.1 版本，在保留全局场景理解能力的同时，为其视频自监督模型系列加入稠密的图像与视频特征。

title.en: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
title.zh: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels

note.en: An end-to-end JEPA trained straight from pixels, replacing the fragile multi-term losses earlier world models relied on.
note.zh: 一种直接从像素端到端训练的 JEPA，取代了早期世界模型所依赖的脆弱多项损失。

title.en: Representation Learning for Spatiotemporal Physical Systems
title.zh: Representation Learning for Spatiotemporal Physical Systems

note.en: Moves machine learning for physical systems past next-frame prediction toward representations of the underlying dynamics.
note.zh: 让面向物理系统的机器学习超越下一帧预测，转向学习底层动力学的表征。

title.en: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
title.zh: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning

note.en: Reshapes pretrained visual features by straightening their trajectories over time so they suit planning rather than only recognition.
note.zh: 通过在时间上“拉直”轨迹来重塑预训练视觉特征，使其适合规划而不只是识别。

title.en: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
title.zh: The Spike, the Sparse and the Sink: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks

note.en: An anatomy of two recurring transformer phenomena — massive activations in a few channels, and attention sinks.
note.zh: 剖析 Transformer 中两个反复出现的现象：少数通道上的巨大激活值，以及注意力汇聚点。

title.en: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade
title.zh: AI+HW 2035: Shaping the Next Decade

note.en: A ten-year community roadmap for AI and hardware co-design, which he signed alongside some thirty other researchers.
note.zh: 一份关于 AI 与硬件协同设计的十年社区路线图，他与另外约三十位研究者共同署名。

title.en: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
title.zh: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining

note.en: Maps the design space for native multimodal pretraining, arguing vision is the critical axis for pushing foundation models beyond language.
note.zh: 梳理原生多模态预训练的设计空间，主张视觉是推动基础模型超越语言的关键维度。

title.en: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?
title.zh: What Drives Success in Physical Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models?

note.en: A study probing what makes joint-embedding predictive (JEPA) world models succeed at physical planning tasks — his lab's core research direction.
note.zh: 一篇研究联合嵌入预测（JEPA）世界模型在物理规划任务中成功要素的论文，属于其团队的核心研究方向。

title.en: EP20: Yann LeCun
title.zh: EP20: Yann LeCun

note.en: A near two-hour interview on The Information Bottleneck in which he lays out his case that training ever larger LLMs will not reach AGI.
note.zh: 在 The Information Bottleneck 播客中近两小时的访谈，他系统阐述了为何不断把大语言模型做大也到不了 AGI。

title.en: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos
title.zh: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos

note.en: A world-model approach that learns dexterous robotic hand-object manipulation by watching human videos.
note.zh: 一种世界模型方法，通过观看人类操作视频来学习灵巧的机械手–物体交互。

title.en: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language
title.zh: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language

note.en: Extends his joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to combined vision-language representation learning.
note.zh: 将其提出的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）扩展到视觉-语言联合表征学习。

title.en: @ChrisMurphyCT You're being played by people who want regulatory capture. They are scaring everyone with dubious studies so that open source models are regulate
title.zh: @ChrisMurphyCT You're being played by people who want regulatory capture. They are scaring everyone with dubious studies so that open source models are regulate

note.en: Accuses AI-safety alarmism of serving regulatory capture, arguing dubious studies are being used to push open-source models out of the market.
note.zh: 他指责渲染AI风险的说法服务于监管俘获，认为这类可疑研究意在将开源模型排挤出市场。

title.en: Cambrian-S: Towards Spatial Supersensing in Video
title.zh: Cambrian-S: Towards Spatial Supersensing in Video

note.en: Introduces Cambrian-S, a video model aimed at 'spatial supersensing' — building richer spatial understanding from video streams.
note.zh: 提出Cambrian-S模型，致力于视频中的'空间超感知'，从视频流中构建更丰富的空间理解能力。

title.en: MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning
title.zh: MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning

note.en: Meta FAIR work on MetaMorph, an instruction-tuned model unifying multimodal understanding and generation in one system.
note.zh: Meta FAIR的MetaMorph研究，通过指令微调将多模态理解与生成统一在同一模型中。

title.en: Scaling Language-Free Visual Representation Learning
title.zh: Scaling Language-Free Visual Representation Learning

note.en: Shows that purely visual (language-free) representation learning scales competitively with language-supervised approaches — part of his push against language-centric AI.
note.zh: 论文表明，纯视觉（无语言监督）的表征学习在扩展规模后可与语言监督方法竞争，呼应其反对以语言为中心的AI路线的立场。

title.en: Gaussian Embeddings: How JEPAs Secretly Learn Your Data Density
title.zh: Gaussian Embeddings: How JEPAs Secretly Learn Your Data Density

note.en: Argues that JEPA-style self-supervised models implicitly learn the underlying data density, formalized through Gaussian embeddings.
note.zh: 论文提出JEPA类自监督模型实际上隐式学习了数据的概率密度，并通过高斯嵌入加以形式化。

title.en: Attention Sinks and Compression Valleys in LLMs are Two Sides of the Same Coin
title.zh: Attention Sinks and Compression Valleys in LLMs are Two Sides of the Same Coin

note.en: Co-authored analysis connecting two known LLM internals phenomena — attention sinks and compression valleys — as the same underlying effect.
note.zh: 合著论文将大语言模型中两个已知现象——注意力汇聚（attention sinks）与压缩谷（compression valleys）——联系为同一潜在效应的两面。

title.en: LLM-JEPA: Large Language Models Meet Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures
title.zh: LLM-JEPA: Large Language Models Meet Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures

note.en: Brings his JEPA framework to large language models, testing the predictive-embedding approach outside vision.
note.zh: 将其JEPA框架引入大语言模型，把预测式嵌入方法拓展到视觉领域之外。

title.en: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
title.zh: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning

note.en: V-JEPA 2, the next generation of his video world-model architecture, enabling understanding, prediction and robotic planning from self-supervised video learning.
note.zh: V-JEPA 2是其视频世界模型架构的新一代版本，通过自监督视频学习实现理解、预测与机器人规划能力。

title.en: RoboPEPP: Vision-Based Robot Pose and Joint Angle Estimation through Embedding Predictive Pre-Training
title.zh: RoboPEPP: Vision-Based Robot Pose and Joint Angle Estimation through Embedding Predictive Pre-Training

note.en: RoboPEPP applies embedding-predictive pre-training, in the spirit of JEPA, to estimate robot pose and joint angles from vision.
note.zh: RoboPEPP将嵌入预测式预训练（延续JEPA思路）应用于通过视觉估计机器人姿态与关节角度。

title.en: Yann LeCun: Human Intelligence is not General Intelligence
title.zh: Yann LeCun: Human Intelligence is not General Intelligence

note.en: An interview on the limits of today's LLMs and what he thinks is still missing for human-level intelligence.
note.zh: 访谈，讨论当今大语言模型的局限，以及他认为通往人类水平智能还缺少什么。

title.en: Why Can't AI Make Its Own Discoveries? — With Yann LeCun
title.zh: Why Can't AI Make Its Own Discoveries? — With Yann LeCun

note.en: He joins Big Technology Podcast to explain why current models have been unable to invent anything genuinely new.
note.zh: 做客 Big Technology 播客，解释为什么现有模型始终无法真正发明出新东西。

title.en: New paper: turns out you can train deep nets without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh()
title.zh: New paper: turns out you can train deep nets without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh()

note.en: Shares a new result showing deep networks can be trained without normalization layers by replacing them with a parameterized tanh function.
note.zh: 分享一项新研究：用参数化的tanh函数替代归一化层，深度网络无需归一化层也能训练。

title.en: To people who think "China is surpassing the US in AI" the correct thought is "Open source models are surpassing closed ones" See ⬇️⬇️⬇️
title.zh: To people who think "China is surpassing the US in AI" the correct thought is "Open source models are surpassing closed ones" See ⬇️⬇️⬇️

note.en: Reframes the 'China is surpassing the US in AI' narrative as really being about open-source models surpassing closed ones — a core plank of his open-source advocacy.
note.zh: 他将'中国在AI上超越美国'的说法重新定义为'开源模型正在超越闭源模型'，这是他倡导开源的核心论点。

title.en: Meta's Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun Makes the Case for Open Source
title.zh: Meta's Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun Makes the Case for Open Source

note.en: A live interview with Kara Swisher making his case for open-source AI and answering the risks critics attach to it.
note.zh: 与 Kara Swisher 的现场访谈，他为开源 AI 辩护，并回应批评者提出的种种风险。

title.en: I don't wanna say "I told you so", but I told you so. Quote: "Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of AI labs Safe Superintelligence (SSI) and OpenAI, told Reuters recent
title.zh: I don't wanna say "I told you so", but I told you so. Quote: "Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of AI labs Safe Superintelligence (SSI) and OpenAI, told Reuters recent

note.en: Cites Ilya Sutskever's remark that pre-training scaling has plateaued as vindication of his own long-standing skepticism about scaling laws.
note.zh: 他援引伊利亚·苏茨克维关于预训练规模化已见顶的表态，视为对自己长期以来质疑规模化定律的印证。

title.en: Worth repeating: Do not confuse retrieval with reasoning. Do not confuse rote learning with understanding. Do not confuse accumulated knowledge with intelligenc
title.zh: Worth repeating: Do not confuse retrieval with reasoning. Do not confuse rote learning with understanding. Do not confuse accumulated knowledge with intelligenc

note.en: Restates his core argument against LLM-centric AGI claims: don't mistake retrieval for reasoning, or accumulated knowledge for intelligence.
note.zh: 重申其反对'LLM即通往AGI之路'论调的核心观点：不要把检索误当作推理，也不要把知识积累误当作智能。

title.en: Congrats John and Geoff! Both are former colleagues. I did my postdoc in Geoff's lab in Toronto. After that, I joined Bell Labs, where John was a part-time scie
title.zh: Congrats John and Geoff! Both are former colleagues. I did my postdoc in Geoff's lab in Toronto. After that, I joined Bell Labs, where John was a part-time scie

note.en: Congratulates former mentors John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton on their Nobel Prize, recalling his postdoc under Hinton and time alongside Hopfield at Bell Labs.
note.zh: 祝贺前导师约翰·霍普菲尔德和杰弗里·辛顿获得诺贝尔奖，并回忆自己在辛顿门下做博士后及在贝尔实验室与霍普菲尔德共事的经历。

title.en: #416 – Yann Lecun: Meta AI, Open Source, Limits of LLMs, AGI & the Future of AI
title.zh: #416 – Yann Lecun: Meta AI, Open Source, Limits of LLMs, AGI & the Future of AI

note.en: A long-form conversation with Lex Fridman on Meta AI, open source, the limits of LLMs and his own route to human-level intelligence.
note.zh: 与 Lex Fridman 的长谈，涉及 Meta AI、开源、大语言模型的局限，以及他自己设想的通往人类水平智能的路径。

title.en: #258 – Yann LeCun: Dark Matter of Intelligence and Self-Supervised Learning
title.zh: #258 – Yann LeCun: Dark Matter of Intelligence and Self-Supervised Learning

note.en: A conversation with Lex Fridman on self-supervised learning as the dark matter of intelligence.
note.zh: 与 Lex Fridman 对谈，讨论作为智能“暗物质”的自监督学习。

title.en: Yann LeCun: Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Self-Supervised Learning
title.zh: Yann LeCun: Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Self-Supervised Learning

note.en: An early Lex Fridman interview covering deep learning, convolutional networks and self-supervised learning.
note.zh: 早期的 Lex Fridman 访谈，涵盖深度学习、卷积网络与自监督学习。

title.zh: APPSO独家｜杨立昆再联手谢赛宁，英伟达参投，新公司押注 LLM 之后

body.en: LeCun teamed up again with Saining Xie to launch a new company betting on a post-LLM approach to AI, with Nvidia among the investors.
body.zh: 杨立昆再度与谢赛宁联手创立一家新公司，押注LLM之后的AI技术路线，英伟达是投资方之一。

title.en: 杨立昆AI初创公司获10.3亿美元融资，英伟达三星参投
title.zh: 杨立昆AI初创公司获10.3亿美元融资，英伟达三星参投

body.en: LeCun's startup AMI Labs raised $1.03 billion, with Nvidia and Samsung among the investors.
body.zh: 杨立昆的初创公司AMI Labs获得10.3亿美元融资，英伟达和三星等参与投资。

title.en: 刚刚！杨立昆成功融资70亿，黄仁勋参与投资
title.zh: 刚刚！杨立昆成功融资70亿，黄仁勋参与投资

body.en: LeCun's AMI Labs closed a $7 billion funding round, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang participating as an investor.
body.zh: 杨立昆创立的AMI Labs完成70亿美元融资，英伟达CEO黄仁勋参与投资。

title.en: Yann LeCun’s New AI Paper Argues AGI Is Misdefined and Introduces Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence (SAI) Instead
title.zh: Yann LeCun’s New AI Paper Argues AGI Is Misdefined and Introduces Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence (SAI) Instead

body.en: LeCun's new paper argues AGI is a poorly defined goal and proposes 'Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence' (SAI) as a better framing.
body.zh: 杨立昆新论文认为AGI是一个定义不清的目标，提出以"超人类适应性智能"（SAI）作为更好的替代框架。

title.en: Why Yann LeCun left Meta, and what it means for AI’s next frontier
title.zh: Why Yann LeCun left Meta, and what it means for AI’s next frontier

body.en: An analysis of why LeCun left Meta to pursue his non-autoregressive vision for AI, and what his departure signals for the field's next direction.
body.zh: 分析了杨立昆为何离开Meta、转而追求其非自回归AI理念，以及这一离职对该领域下一步方向的意义。

title.en: 人形机器人生产效率不到人类一半？杨立昆泼冷水：没一个聪明的！
title.zh: 人形机器人生产效率不到人类一半？杨立昆泼冷水：没一个聪明的！

body.en: Yann LeCun publicly dismissed humanoid robots as far from intelligent, noting their production efficiency is still less than half that of humans.
body.zh: 杨立昆公开泼冷水，称人形机器人远算不上智能，其生产效率仍不到人类的一半。

title.en: Nexar Appoints AI Pioneer Yann LeCun to Board as Physical AI Scales Beyond the Lab
title.zh: Nexar Appoints AI Pioneer Yann LeCun to Board as Physical AI Scales Beyond the Lab

body.en: LeCun was appointed to the board of Nexar as the company scales physical AI beyond the lab.
body.zh: LeCun被任命为Nexar公司董事会成员，该公司正推动物理AI技术走出实验室、实现规模化应用。

title.en: Nexar Appoints AI Pioneer Yann LeCun to Board as Physical AI Scales Beyond the Lab
title.zh: Nexar Appoints AI Pioneer Yann LeCun to Board as Physical AI Scales Beyond the Lab

body.en: LeCun joined the board of Nexar, a physical-AI company, as it scales beyond research settings.
body.zh: LeCun加入了物理AI公司Nexar的董事会，该公司业务正从研究环境走向规模化落地。

title.en: 杨立昆自曝离开Meta内幕：与扎克伯格不合，对29岁新上司不满，力挺“世界模型”遭冷落
title.zh: 杨立昆自曝离开Meta内幕：与扎克伯格不合，对29岁新上司不满，力挺“世界模型”遭冷落

body.en: LeCun gave a detailed account of why he left Meta: friction with Zuckerberg, dissatisfaction with a new 29-year-old superior, and frustration that his push for world models was sidelined.
body.zh: 杨立昆详细披露了他离开Meta的内幕：与扎克伯格不合、对29岁新上司不满，以及他力推的'世界模型'路线遭到冷落。

title.en: 雷军回应小字营销：行业陋习，立刻马上就改；破防！腾讯元宝罕见辱骂用户，官方紧急致歉；杨立昆爆猛料：Meta模型靠作弊刷分上榜
title.zh: 雷军回应小字营销：行业陋习，立刻马上就改；破防！腾讯元宝罕见辱骂用户，官方紧急致歉；杨立昆爆猛料：Meta模型靠作弊刷分上榜

body.en: LeCun was reported to have revealed that Meta's models climbed leaderboard rankings by gaming benchmarks, a pointed claim about his former employer's practices.
body.zh: 据报道，杨立昆爆料称Meta的模型是通过“刷分”手段登上排行榜的，这是他对前东家做法的一次尖锐指控。

title.en: 杨立昆披露离职Meta内幕，团队被迫作弊刷榜遭边缘化
title.zh: 杨立昆披露离职Meta内幕，团队被迫作弊刷榜遭边缘化

body.en: LeCun gave his own account of leaving Meta, alleging his team was pressured to game benchmark leaderboards and was sidelined internally.
body.zh: LeCun披露了自己离开Meta的内幕，称团队曾被迫在排行榜上作弊刷分，并在内部遭到边缘化。

title.en: 杨立昆：Meta新人满脑子都是大语言模型但这是一条死胡同- AI 人工智能
title.zh: 杨立昆：Meta新人满脑子都是大语言模型但这是一条死胡同- AI 人工智能

body.en: LeCun says Meta newcomers are fixated on large language models, which he calls a dead end, reiterating his contrarian stance on the path to AGI.
body.zh: 杨立昆表示Meta的新员工满脑子都是大语言模型，他认为这是一条死胡同，重申了他对通往AGI路径的不同看法。

title.en: AI 科学家杨立昆离职后曝 Meta 模型作弊刷榜
title.zh: AI 科学家杨立昆离职后曝 Meta 模型作弊刷榜

body.en: After leaving Meta, LeCun said Meta's AI models had gamed leaderboard rankings.
body.zh: 杨立昆离开Meta后表示，Meta的AI模型曾在排行榜上刷分作弊。

title.en: 杨立昆谈从Meta离职原因 扎克伯格使双方沟通陷入僵局
title.zh: 杨立昆谈从Meta离职原因 扎克伯格使双方沟通陷入僵局

body.en: LeCun described why he left Meta, saying a breakdown in communication with Zuckerberg was a key factor.
body.zh: 杨立昆谈及离开Meta的原因，称与扎克伯格沟通陷入僵局是关键因素之一。

was.zh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家（离职中）
